name: filter-assistant
title: FilterAssistant
description: Natural-language filtering with a review step: useFilterAssistant sends the prompt, current filter, a JSON Schema of your fields, time context and an AbortSignal to your own resolve callback (any provider), sanitizes the answer against the field allowlist, and turns it into a proposal. FilterAssistant (prompt, stop, status, actions slot for VoiceInput) and FilterProposal (added/changed/removed chips with Accept/Reject, needs-input chips, what couldn't be used, one-tap clarification choices, optional result-count preview, Apply/Apply all/Discard). Nothing reaches the filter until applied, and applying is one undo step. Model text renders as text only.
